selection: Validation accuracy only; earliest epoch and first config win ties. Test read only after selecting each method.
split: Fixed PyG Planetoid public split; NormalizeFeatures. Seed variability is not split variability.
controls: feature_all=exp(-distance/median positive edge distance); feature_support=same kernel restricted to positive NRS support and rescaled to same total weight; random_support=positive NRS weights randomly relocated without replacement across structural undirected edges (preserves count and multiset, not node degrees). alpha fixed for every weighted method, no alpha search.
budget: Four downstream fits of 200 epochs per method per seed; one fresh warmup per seed shared by NRS-dependent controls. Equal downstream search count, not equal total compute; all preprocessing and tuning time reported.
inference: Paired seed differences with t 95% CI and two-sided paired t tests, Holm over 8 NRS-vs-control comparisons. Conditional on two public splits. No claim of dataset-population inference.
temporal_gate: Proceed to temporal utility experiment only if NRS has positive mean vs all 4 controls on BOTH datasets and Holm-adjusted p<0.05 vs plain on both. Otherwise report no-go for Q1 utility expansion under this protocol; no post-hoc tuning to reverse outcome.
scope: Bounded pilot, not a comprehensive Q1 qualification test. Does not retest historical selected alpha or tune tau. Negative results retained.
